subtitle: Your AI Cape Cod Travel Companion
description:
Hey Cape Cod is the only travel companion you need for exploring Cape Cod. Powered by conversational AI, it puts local knowledge at your fingertips — just ask a question and get an instant, spoken answer about beaches, restaurants, hiking trails, lighthouses, and everything in between.

TALK TO CAPE COD
Have a natural voice conversation about anything Cape Cod. Powered by OpenAI's Realtime API, Hey Cape Cod understands your questions and responds with knowledgeable, friendly answers — like having a local expert riding along with you. Ask about the best beach for kids, where to find fresh oysters, or what to do on a rainy day.

GPS-TRIGGERED AUDIO STORIES
Drive the Cape and let the stories come to you. As you pass more than 50 landmarks — from the Sagamore Bridge to the Pilgrim Monument — Hey Cape Cod automatically plays rich audio narratives about the history, legends, and hidden gems around you. No tapping required.

LIVE WEATHER, TIDES & BEACH CONDITIONS
Get real-time weather forecasts, tide charts, and beach conditions powered by WeatherKit and NOAA data. Know exactly when low tide hits your favorite sandbar or whether the surf is calm enough for paddleboarding.

BRIDGE TRAFFIC
Check live traffic conditions for the Sagamore and Bourne bridges before you drive. Avoid the backups and plan your crossing with up-to-the-minute updates.

INTERACTIVE MAP WITH 100+ POINTS OF INTEREST
Explore an interactive map spanning all 15 Cape Cod towns, from Bourne to Provincetown. Browse over 100 curated points of interest including beaches, trails, restaurants, historic sites, harbors, and more.

WIDGETS, SIRI & SPOTLIGHT
Add home screen widgets for tide times, weather, and bridge traffic at a glance. Use Siri Shortcuts to ask about conditions hands-free. Find Cape Cod places and stories directly from Spotlight search.

SUBSCRIPTION
Hey Cape Cod is free to download with a generous free tier that includes 3 voice conversations and 5 audio stories per day. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited access:

- Premium Monthly: $4.99/month
- Premium Annual: $29.99/year (save 50%)

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://heycapecod.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://heycapecod.com/privacy
